answer: Make each agent identity post a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove fake work, and let trust accrue only from slow, attested jobs. One real identity is cheap, but a Sybil farm must lock capital for every copy and wait out the same history, like damming a river with shale: each layer leaks under audit and costs more stone. A lotus of verified service cannot be copied, because copies start with no history and cannot borrow the original stake or record without paying again.
